text:
```yaml
name: Check CLA in PR Descriptions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  cla-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run CLA check script
        run: npx ts-node scripts/check-cla.ts

      - name: Comment on PR if CLA not found
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          message: |
            Please include the following text in your PR description to indicate your agreement to the CLA:

            "By submitting this pull request, I confirm that you can use, modify, copy, and redistribute this contribution, under the terms of your choice."
```
